question: DGRZ is related to HNVG in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, TIHB is related to XPLI. To which of the given options is FDTW related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/69a2832bc87cbf471d2bebb73ea5e3f22b2585b29caf9f9406f09cf2772a4d7d.png] 

The logic followed here is:

For **DGRZ → HNVG**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d5e704a08fcfa07bc431932a034f506244ff15d4a8102109ffb4964b85ffe2e.png] 

For **TIHB → XPLI**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5d82e3c9b23dafc3fb18fb4cbb9e6a706b5bf086a7fb58b44c9d69f8d25da596.png] 

Similarly, for **FDTW**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/23408312df87e3aba0b77e1d722c8ccfd7b99ba5caca9c639fa35984bf0b3f80.png] 

So, **FDTW** will be related to **JKXD.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.
